title: Bonds are the market that bosses the others
hook: Everyone talks about stocks. So why do professionals watch bonds instead?
metaphor: A bond is an IOU with a tip attached. You lend money, and you get paid a little extra for waiting.
body: That tip is called the yield. It is the price of borrowing money.
Every other price is judged against it. Why own anything paying less?
So when bond yields move, stocks, gold, and the dollar all react.
Learn bonds first and the rest of the map gets easier.

caveat: Yields also move on supply, foreign buying, and panic — not only on Fed expectations.
